description: K.P. Christy Joy and Another v. Samuel A. Meshadurai K.P. Christy Joy and Another v. Samuel A. Meshadurai View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: K.P. Christy Joy and Another v. Samuel A. Meshadurai K.P. Christy Joy and Another v. Samuel A. Meshadurai View More
keywords: The Petitioners sought to revise and set aside the consent judgement of the District Court of Jaffna, requiring them to prove co-ownership or vacate the land in suit. Held - no exceptional circumstances existed; affirmed the binding nature of the consent decree. Application dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
